resources.string: Sets the lowest and highest refresh rate of the screen. A higher rate looks smoother but uses more battery. Fixed options keep the screen at that rate. Every change is written to the journal and can be undone from the History tab.
Applied. The system accepted the new range.
Written, but the system reports something different (%1$s Hz). This ROM may not use the setting the way we expect.
Written, but the system report could not be read. Could not verify the result.
